description: 7 exemplars + 4 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Exemplars cover the six lanes that produce hand-authored SVG — a glyph the incumbent set lacks, a simple geometric mark, an animated asset, a surgical edit to an existing file, an SVG diagram, and a raster converted to a vector — plus the German phrasing of the first, which is the lane a consumer reaches for most often. Near-misses are the four neighbours this skill sits between that share its vocabulary and are still somebody else's job: an icon the set already has (iconography), a full brand pipeline (logo-generation), provider choice for vector art (image-provider-routing), and reduced-motion policy (fe-design § Motion, which this skill points at and never restates). Counterexamples guard the two directions this skill could over-trigger in without sharing its subject at all: raster generation, and video motion choreography — both say 'make me an image' or 'animate' without any vector surface.

queries.q: draw an SVG icon the set does not have — a 'split branch' glyph matching our Lucide stroke
zeichne ein SVG-Icon, das unser Set nicht hat — ein Glyph für 'Zweig teilen' im Lucide-Strichstil
author a simple geometric mark as SVG — two overlapping circles, brand blue, no text
animate this logo SVG so the ring draws on over 800ms
change only the hat in this SVG and leave everything else byte-identical
turn the logo in this PNG into a real vector without the app name
hand-place an SVG architecture diagram — five boxes and typed edges
which Heroicons name is the download action?
queries.note: the set already has it → iconography

queries.q: generate a logo for my bakery called Golden Crust
which provider should I use for complex illustrative vector art?
queries.note: says vector and still asks a routing question → image-provider-routing

queries.q: what is our policy on prefers-reduced-motion durations across the app?
queries.note: motion policy → fe-design § Motion; this skill points at it and never restates it

queries.q: generate a photoreal hero image of a coffee shop at dawn
queries.note: raster generation with no vector surface at all → image-generation

queries.q: choreograph the camera move and the cut timing for this product video
queries.note: video motion, shares only the word animate → motion-choreographer
